# Firmcraft

> Firmcraft advises business owners and executive teams on artificial
> intelligence and technology strategy, implements what the strategy requires,
> and manages the result on an ongoing basis. The practice brings together
> business process, industry, and enterprise systems experience with hands-on
> technical implementation.

Firmcraft works with organizations where the owner, the chief executive, or
senior leadership drives the technology agenda, from owner-led businesses to the
executive teams of larger enterprises. The practice is independent: it does not
resell software and does not receive vendor margin.

## Practice
- [Advisory](https://firmcraft.ai/advisory): advisory, managed AI services, and infrastructure
- [How We Work](https://firmcraft.ai/how-we-work): assessment, implementation, and ongoing support
- [Data Sovereignty](https://firmcraft.ai/sovereignty): how client data is handled and where systems run
- [For Small Business](https://firmcraft.ai/for-small-business): managed artificial intelligence capability for smaller organizations
